an3.109:1.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍako gahapati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍakaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
an3.109:1.2: Citte gahapati arakkhite kāyakammam pi arakkhitaṃ hoti vacīkammam pi arakkhitaṃ hoti manokammam pi arakkhitaṃ hoti.
an3.109:1.3: Tassa arakkhitakāyakammantassa arakkhitavacī-kammantassa arakkhitamanokammantassa kāyakammam pi avassutaṃ hoti . . . manokammam pi avassutaṃ hoti.
an3.109:1.4: Tassa avassutakāyakammantassa . . . avassutamanokammantassa kāyakammam pi pūtikaṃ hoti . . . pe . . . manokammam pi pūtikaṃ hoti.
an3.109:1.5: Tassa pūtikāyakammantassa . . . pe . . . pūtimanokammantassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an3.109:2.1: Seyyathāpi gahapati kūṭāgāre ducchanne kūṭam pi arakkhitaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyo pi arakkhitā honti bhitti pi arakkhitā hoti
an3.109:2.2: kūṭam pi avassutaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyo pi avassutā honti bhitti pi avassutā hoti
an3.109:2.3: kūṭam pi pūtikaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyo pi pūtikā honti bhitti pi pūtikā hoti,
an3.109:3.1: evam eva kho gahapati citte arakkhite kāyakammam pi arakkhitaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.109:4.1: Citte gahapati rakkhite kāyakammam pi rakkhitaṃ hoti . . . pe . . . manokammam pi rakkhitaṃ hoti.
an3.109:4.2: Tassa rakkhitakāyakammantassa . . . pe . . . rakkhitamanokammantassa kāyakammam pi anavassutaṃ hoti . . . pe . . . manokammam pi anavassutaṃ hoti.
an3.109:4.3: Tassa anavassutakāyakammantassa . . . pe . . . anavassutamanokammantassa kāyakammam pi apūtikaṃ hoti . . . pe . . . manokammam pi apūtikaṃ hoti.
an3.109:4.4: Tassa apūtikāyakammantassa . . . pe . . . apūtimanokammantassa bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti bhaddikā kālakiriyā.
an3.109:5.1: Seyyathāpi gahapati kūṭāgāre succhanne kūṭam pi rakkhitaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyo pi rakkhitā honti bhitti pi rakkhitā hoti
an3.109:5.2: kūṭam pi anavassutaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyo pi anavassutā honti bhitti pi anavassutā hoti
an3.109:5.3: kūṭam pi apūtikaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyo pi apūtikā honti bhitti pi apūtikā hoti,
an3.109:6.1: evaṃ eva kho gahapati citte rakkhite kāyakammam pi rakkhitaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
